do_not_assume: A status is sufficient to represent every state.
A visible label is the stored value.
A successful final message proves every side effect.
goal: A reviewable process model before configuration begins.
steps: Restate the underlying ministry problem without naming the proposed screen or automation.
Generate at least three materially different approaches, including a non-workflow option when credible.
Select the workflow approach only if it adds useful state, assignment, branching, automation, or auditability.
Define the subject person or entity.
List initiation data, derived data, and retained data as attributes.
Define activities by responsibility or stage.
Define actions in execution order.
Define commands, branch criteria, completion, retries, and failure handling.
Define security and sensitive-data retention.
Define the launch surface and acceptance evidence.
title: Recipe: Design a bounded workflow type

do_not_assume: Stop when visibility is explained; do not alter the workflow instance merely to force it onto a list.
goal: A field change that preserves validation, visibility, and downstream behavior.
steps: Identify the workflow type, Form action, and attribute key.
Record the current field type and stored-value format.
Inspect visible, editable, required, and conditional settings.
Inspect Person Entry implications.
Find every action filter, Set Attribute action, communication, report, and integration that consumes the value.
Test every conditional branch, including omitted-field behavior.
Submit a disposable instance.
Inspect stored values and downstream outcomes.
Verify access as public user, staff user, assignee, and unauthorized user where applicable.

Confirm the workflow type is active and the expected category is selected in the block settings.
Check category and workflow-type View permissions.
For Workflow Entry, confirm there is an active Form action assigned to the current person and that the person can view the activity.
For My Workflows, confirm the activity is active, has an active form, is assigned appropriately, and the person can view it.
Verify login, form start/end dates, and share-link settings when using Form Builder.

title: Recipe: Review a workflow form change

do_not_assume: Defined Values are evaluated as an exclusive first-match list.
goal: One intended request starts only the intended workflow with inspectable input.
steps: Define a stable request discriminator.
Create or inspect the Workflow Webhook Defined Value.
Make Process Request Lava return true only for the intended request.
Compare the rule against every other webhook Defined Value.
Map only bounded request data into workflow attributes.
Store the raw body when structured parsing is needed.
Parse and validate inside the workflow.
Test no-match, one-match, and accidental-multiple-match cases.
Verify authentication and secret handling separately.
Inspect the resulting workflow instance.
title: Recipe: Configure a selective workflow webhook

do_not_assume: Do not treat generated guidance as live-instance proof.
goal: The first incorrect state or action is identified without unsafe replay.
steps: Open Workflow Detail.
Record workflow state, status, initiator, and activation time.
Inspect attributes and raw formats where relevant.
Inspect activated activities and assignments.
Locate the first incomplete or unexpected action.
Inspect its criteria and prior actions.
Read logs and notes.
Verify side effects in their owning Rock records.
Decide whether retry is idempotent.
Re-run only after duplicate and irreversible effects are ruled out.
title: Recipe: Diagnose an active workflow instance

do_not_assume: A missing card means the request itself is wrong.
goal: A Connection process is understood as both person context and operational state.
steps: Identify the person and request.
Record Connection Type, Opportunity, status, campus, connector, assignee, and next action.
Inspect activity and workflow relationships.
Compare Board and List visibility.
Check filters and current-user security.
Identify staff ownership and completion criteria.
Inspect active requests before changing Type or Opportunity configuration.
Reconcile reporting dependencies.
Verify the final staff work queue after any approved change.
title: Recipe: Audit a connection follow-up process

goal: An imported or cloned workflow is validated before activation.
steps: Identify source version, required plugins, action components, and external references.
Use Test Only mode for import.
Inspect import warnings and the exported package.
Place the workflow in an intentional security category.
Verify attributes, field types, forms, activities, action order, and component settings.
Replace organization-specific communications, groups, campuses, pages, Defined Values, and Connection Opportunities.
Test with disposable instances.
Verify logs, assignments, communications, and side effects.
Connect the live trigger only after validation.

do_not_assume: Do not treat generated guidance as live-instance proof.
goal: Slow work proceeds asynchronously with explicit operational state.
steps: Define queued, processing, completed, retryable-failure, and terminal-failure states.
Store only the identifiers needed to inspect the external work.
Define retry limits and duplicate suppression.
Define a completion check.
Keep the user-facing request path non-blocking.
Link output into public pages or apps only after completion is verified.
Surface concise staff status without unnecessary raw provider payloads.
Test timeout, duplicate callback, partial success, and final failure.
